title: Ride sidesaddle as a woman in 1835 and 1904
items: Choose a woman in Settings and ride in 1835 or 1904: she is put up on a side saddle, both legs on the near side, her foot in the one stirrup.
Her skirt falls over both knees and down the horse's side, as a riding skirt did, instead of leaving her legs bare.
In 1812 a woman still rides astride, as frontier women did.
